# BAD-005 — Release 0.13.4: desktop downloads plus the iOS build (13004) for the App Store resubmission

## Brief
Cut Bad Takes 0.13.4 by the cutting-a-release skill and docs/RELEASING.md, so App Store Connect gets build 13004 carrying PR #330: guest mode, no ads or in-app purchases, no ATT. BAD-004's resubmission waits on that build.

The desktop release goes out as usual: macOS built, notarized and verified locally, Windows from release.yml on the tag, one gh release create to 0snug0/BadTakes-releases, then the site merge. The iOS leg is npm run dist:ios, then --upload after the desktop gates pass.

Constraints: release from the main checkout, never a worktree. Spudagents cannot git commit, push, tag or merge, so every git step is Spud's. Publishing to the public releases repo, pushing to it, and uploading to App Store Connect each need Eric's explicit go-ahead first. The .ipa never rides on the GitHub release.

## Size, persona and model decision
One opus engineer per phase, run from the BadTakes main checkout on a release branch, because the project forbids releasing from a worktree. Spudagents may not commit, push or tag (Law 7), so each phase ends with a block: Spud does the git steps, then plans the next phase. Publishing to the public releases repo and the App Store Connect upload need Eric's approval first.

## Outcome
Released v0.13.4. Published to https://github.com/0snug0/BadTakes-releases/releases/tag/v0.13.4: 10 binaries confirmed at staged sizes, then latest-mac.yml and latest.yml, 12 assets. Release PR https://github.com/0snug0/BadTakes/pull/335 was squash-merged as d857aa5, and deploy-site succeeded. badtakes.io/downloads.js serves DOWNLOAD_VERSION 0.13.4, and both dmg links and the Windows setup return 200. macOS passed every gate (notarized, verify:signing on every .app and .dmg, asar leak and fonts, SMOKE_OK, kit, UTI). Windows first failed on release.yml's asar checks matching forward slashes against Windows backslash paths; fixed on the branch (fccd7f8, pinned by test/release-workflow.test.js) and green on re-dispatch run 34902746734. The creator kit published on the tag. The iOS .ipa, 0.13.4 (13004), is built with no ATT and sits in dist/ios; there is no App Store Connect API key on this Mac, so Eric uploads it with Transporter, tracked on BAD-004.
